question: India's IDSP P-form (Presumptive case data) is collected only after laboratory confirmation of the causative pathogen.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: The P-form is based on clinical (presumptive) diagnosis without waiting for laboratory confirmation. Lab-confirmed data go on the L-form. The advantage of P-form is speed — it detects outbreaks faster than confirmation can.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — the P-form records presumptive (clinically diagnosed) cases, NOT lab-confirmed cases. This allows early outbreak detection before microbiology results are available.
